tools.name: get_funding_details
tools.description: The US bank account — account number and routing number — plus the USDC address on Base. This is the banking half, so it needs verification to be approved; before that it refuses. On and off ramps are free. For a wallet address that works right now, without verification, use get_wallets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: create_account, check_status, get_funding_details, get_wallets · Public sink: create_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: create_account, check_status, get_funding_details, get_wallets · Public sink: create_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
